verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents per-second or per-minute billing, or billing that stops when an instance is stopped. The auto-shutdown feature is a related control that stops idle machines, not a billing-granularity guarantee. Community posts mention only an 'hourly rate' and a flat monthly Pro tier, neither of which shows sub-hour metering.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I am billed at per-second or per-minute granularity and only while my instance is actually running
